channel.title: CIS 400 - Object-Oriented Design, Implementation, and Testing :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: CIS 400 is being reimagined as a mid-level capstone course, where students use what they have learned in the first two years to create a significant programming project. This is not dissimilar to what the course currently does, but the current model utlizes highly prescriptive milestones that are trivialized by generative AI usage. Course Description A study of concepts and techniques used to produce quality software programs. Object-oriented concepts, models, execution environments, design and testing techniques. Extensive application of these concepts and techniques to the development of non-trivial software programs.
